fusions.name: Buckle Cutter
fusions.desc: Flicks the tip under a strap on an enemy within 3.5 tiles, which deals 4 damage and lowers its armour by 6% for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Unbuckling Sweep
fusions.desc: Rakes the lash through a cone that deals 27 damage to everything within 4.5 tiles and ignores armour. Each enemy hit is left [Sundered] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Lamellar Windings
fusions.desc: Winds the lash around you as a barrier that absorbs the next 22 damage and holds for 8 seconds. Your armour rises by 10% while it holds.

fusions.name: Plate Seams
fusions.desc: Your slashing attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour.
